description: This source file contains an extension for the OnboardingView class, providing asynchronous methods for permission management, monitoring updates, CLI installation, and local gateway probing within the onboarding process of the application.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Refreshes the permission monitoring status asynchronously by calling permissionMonitor.refreshNow().

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability asynchronously, ensuring only one request is processed at a time, then refreshes permissions.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Updates the permission monitoring state based on the provided page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Updates the discovery monitoring state based on the page index, starting or stopping gateway discovery accordingly.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Updates both permission and discovery monitoring states based on page index.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Initiates CLI installation asynchronously, preventing re-entrant calls, and updates CLI status.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Updates the CLI installation location and status.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the local gateway port, then updates the probe status based on the command's expected tokens.
